name: America Chavez

abilityDetails.Damage Reflect: Engellenen hasarın belirtilen kısmı, doğrudan hasar olarak rakibe geri gönderilir.
abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Tek hataya izin vermez. Pasif güç kazanımının yanında E2'si engellenemez olur (isabet genelde dövüşün sonu demektir). Ayrıca hasarı yansıtan reverberation'ı var. Güç kontrolü veya yetenek azaltıcı şampiyon şart.
signatureAbility:
Super Charged
If at least 3 unique Dimensions are active, America Chavez becomes Supercharged, granting the following bonuses:
+[11 - 50]% Dimensional Energy Infusion potency.
Launching a Special 2 during a Heavy Attack provides +1 stack of whichever Dimension was activated.

abilitySections.title: Parallel Dimensions
content: Each hit of a Heavy Attack switches the dormant Dimension in the order they appear below.
When the Heavy Attack ends, or if launching a Special Attack during a Heavy Attack, activate the Dimension for 30 seconds.
Utopian Parallel: Reduce Opponents Fury, Armor Up, Precision, Pierce and Cruelty Buff Potency by 70%.
Dark Dimension: Reflect 40% of hit damage taken as Energy Damage. Damage is capped at [19,025.1].
Negative Zone: Reduce Opponents Ability Power Rate by 60%
Matching Dimensions suffer -15% Duration for each stack.
Whenever affected by a Wither Debuff, remove the most recently activated Parallel Dimension.
While Defending a Quest Node, if activating a Dimension that already has 2 active stacks, she activates 1 random unopened Dimension.

abilitySections.title: Dimensional Energy Infusion - Max 6 Stacks
content: For each unique Parallel Dimension on America Chavez and each Buff on the Opponent, gain the following benefits.
+[4,223.6] Attack Rating.
+[603.66] Energy Resistance.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Charge a Heavy Attack after landing any non combo ending hit of a Basic Attack combo to inflict a Passive Stun for 0.75 seconds. Heavy Attacks launched this way generate 25% less Power on Hit.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Each unique Parallel Dimension creates a Passive Power Gain effect generating 40% of a bar of Power over 1.5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: For the final 3 hits of this Special Attack, America Chavez opens a Portal to an additional Big Bang Dimension. Dealing a burst of Energy Damage equal to 50% hit damage dealt.
These hits gain a bonus effect based on the last Dimension activated:
Utopian Parallel: Deal [8,447.2] additional damage on Hit.
Dark Dimension: Regenerate 12% of hit damage dealt.
Negative Zone: Unblockable.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Activate 1 of each Parallel Dimension.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Super Charged
content: If at least 3 unique Dimensions are active, America Chavez becomes Supercharged, granting the following bonuses:
+[11 - 50]% Dimensional Energy Infusion potency.
Launching a Special 2 during a Heavy Attack provides +1 stack of whichever Dimension was activated.
